title: Supply Chain Delays
summary: This note details a situation where supply chain disruptions increased material lead times from 10 to 16 weeks, putting multiple projects at risk. The owner used a two-pronged approach involving factory partial shipments and field mechanic overtime to keep projects on schedule and maintain customer satisfaction.

key_points.text: Material lead times increased from 10 to 16 weeks
Owner informed customers of bad news
Worked with factory to implement partial shipments
Coordinated with field mechanics to put in significant overtime
Kept all projects on track and maintained customer satisfaction
